item.title: Self-Hosted Port Knocking & Single Packet Authorization: fwknop vs knockd vs SPA Guide 2026
item.description: Port knocking and Single Packet Authorization (SPA) are network security techniques that hide services behind a firewall until a specific sequence of connection attempts or a cryptographic packet reveals them. While cloud providers offer managed security groups, self-hosted infrastructure requires you to implement these access control mechanisms yourself.
